messages:
Ana: Late-shift handoff: quick async standup.
Ana: What I did — finished onboarding scripts for synthia-v3 (tokenizer fix + prompt normalization). Pushed payload schema change to staging.
Ana: Blockers — noticed a regression on 'customer-intent-v2' eval: precision drop after kv-cache tweak, unclear if it's quantization or prompt mismatch.
Ana: Today — will run targeted ablation + get a smoke eval across variants, then leave notes for morning team. @Taylor can you watch the canary?

Sam: Saw the failing eval too. Ran a fast pass on the eval harness.
Sam: Results snippet:
```
$ eval-run --model synthia-v3-smallq --set customer-intent-v2 --batch 64
Summary: accuracy 0.708 (baseline 0.748) — big drop in short-answer cases
Top diff: prompt truncation in examples 12-18
```
Sam: I dumped the raw responses to /tmp/synthia_v3_eval.jsonl and linked to it in the PR comments.

Taylor: I'll take the canary watch. If drop persists after rollback to non-quantized build, we'll pause rollout.
Taylor: Opening quick CR to revert kv-cache change on staging: https://github.com/redwood-inference/synthia/pull/482
Taylor: Ping me @Ana if you want me to flip feature flag 'kv-cache-v2' to false.

Lee: Quick note — I saw similar noise when seq-len distribution shifted. Could be padding/truncation differences. Try running the eval with --preserve-first-token.
Lee: Also added a quick eval job that compares top-k sampling seeds, might be flaky though.

Ana: Thanks. Running ablation now with --preserve-first-token and non-quantized weights.

ci-bot: build 482-staging started by Taylor — tests: unit, smoke-evals. Link: https://ci.redwood/482

deploy-bot: Canary deploy for synthia-v3-smallq started 1799998905 by Taylor. Monitoring logs.

Sam: If CI passes, let's only promote to dedicated after we get the short-answer subset fixed. I'll annotate failing cases in the eval JSONL.

Taylor: CI green. Unit + smoke passed. Leaving canary at 10% throughput for 2h. :thumbsup:

Ana: Update — ablation shows the non-quantized run is within baseline (0.744). So quantization path is likely culprit.
Ana: Action items: 1) rollback quantized artifact for now; 2) add targeted prompt normalization tests for short-answer cases; 3) schedule follow-up with quant team.

Lee: I'll queue a regression test for the short-answer promptset and tag @sam for review.

Sam: ACK. I'll pair with Lee tomorrow morning to triage.

Taylor: I'll flip the kv-cache-v2 flag if you confirm rollback. Otherwise keeping canary steady.

Ana: Leaving detailed notes in the onboarding doc and the PR. Thanks all — leaving handoff here. :wave:
